subject: Startups
title: When to Pivot
description: A 60-second lesson on When to Pivot.

hook.text: Founders face a brutal question: is this just a rough patch, or is the whole idea fundamentally wrong?

buildup.text: Signs you need a pivot: users sign up but don't return, growth flatlines despite effort, or nobody will pay.

discovery.text: The best signal is qualitative: users like your product but use it in ways you never intended.

twist.text: Pivoting too early wastes learning. Pivoting too late wastes time and money. Timing is everything.

climax.text: Great founders develop a gut sense: try hard, measure honestly, and pivot when the data says so.

punchline.text: The right time to pivot is after data, not despair.

quiz.question: What's a strong signal that a pivot may be needed?
options: Users use your product in unexpected ways
